title: Benchmark Report Launch — Editorial Calendar (v1)
content:
Last updated: 2025-07-18 (post-launch clean-up + dates locked)

Campaign: Public benchmark report on production inference economics (latency/$) + interactive web experience + PDF report + blog post.
Launch target (external): Tue 2025-07-15 09:00 PT (web + PDF + blog + email). Webinar same week.

Publishing surfaces:
- Marketing site landing page + interactive benchmark table
- Blog post (long-form narrative)
- Downloadable PDF report (gated + ungated variants TBD; see Notes)
- Lifecycle email(s) + outbound enablement copy
- Social (X/LinkedIn) + community (HN/Reddit/Discord) posts
- Partner amplification (marketplace/newsletters)
- Analyst pre-brief + embargo package

Key review gates (must hit in this order):
1) Methodology sign-off (Applied ML + Runtime + Infra): Jonas Weber, Claire Dubois, Mateo Alvarez, Neha Kapoor
2) Claims language review (Legal): Michael Grant, Sofia Mendes
3) Security review of public artifacts (redaction, operational sensitivity): Naomi Feldman
4) Final executive checkpoint (sponsor): Camila Reyes / Jordan Blake (final headlines + press quote alignment)

================================================================================

================================================================================
NOTES / OPEN ITEMS (captured during planning)
================================================================================
- Gating: default plan is ungated blog + landing page; PDF may be ungated (preferred) unless Sales requests gating for enterprise list-building. If gated, ensure legal disclaimers remain visible before form submit.
- Single source of truth for disclaimers: reuse landing page disclaimers verbatim in blog + PDF footnotes.
- Analytics: ensure benchmark page events fire (filter changes, export clicks, CTA clicks) and UTMs are consistent across email/social/partners.
- Embargo: partner + analyst assets distributed 07/11 with clear embargo to 07/15 09:00 PT.
- If a last-minute benchmark data refresh occurs: publish as “v1.0 dataset” and plan “v1.1 addendum” blog rather than silently changing numbers.

Contact / working channel: #marketing (launch) + #eng-platform (benchmark JSON serving) + #eng-ml (methodology)

- PMM: Soojin Lee
- Legal: Michael Grant (primary), Sofia Mendes (backup)
- Security: Naomi Feldman
- Eng bench leads: Jonas Weber / Claire Dubois
